posts.name: Oaktree
posts.cooked:
I thought going in that Wraith getting a Throat Jab card was going to be key.

And that Chrono-Ranger was going to deal a lot of damage.  I was half-expecting that the last turn was going to be Hunter & Hunted, followed by Sudden Contract (for something like 9 damage) and then standard power for another 9.

Nightmist getting max cards and settling in to redirect Afflicted Frenzy damage also struck me as being the optimal play.

Randomizer has tossed out an interesting mix with the Ennead, but I'll save that for an episode or two from now.

posts.name: PlatinumWarlock
posts.cooked: I thought about using Hunter and Hunted, but the three packets of 6 effectively did just as much damage without the risk from Hunter and Hunted.  I absolutely would have used it the next round, had I still been alive, to go out in a blaze of glory.
